استنظرن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْظَرْنَ (istanẓarna) /is.tan.ðˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# اُسْتُنْظِرْنَ (ustunẓirna) /us.tun.ðˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# اِسْتَنْظِرْنَ (istanẓirna) /is.tan.ðˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
